name: argon_one_power_fan
description: Power button, power-off signal and fan control for Argon ONE cases (beta)
author: Andrew Pono

volumio_info.details: BETA. Power button handling (double tap reboots, hold shuts down), optional power-off signal over the UART, and fan control for Argon ONE cases that use Argon's argon1.sh (V2 tested; V1, V3 and V5 should work but are untested). Needs no packages beyond the plugin itself.
